- Duplicates: none (T6), so no flag.
- Purchase inside window at a listed retailer, no receipt required (T4).
- Destruction photo check was inconclusive (T5: only one side visible, not clearly marker writing on front and rear). That would be needs_info, but deny takes precedence in the ordering.

Outcome: deny, because the legible label shows a non-recalled model.
